description: Repo-scale (cpp-eventbus): EventBus::bulkSubscribe must reject the whole batch if the CUMULATIVE subscriber count would exceed maxSubscribersPerTopic - not check each callback against a stale pre-batch baseline
prompts: Add an optional `maxSubscribersPerTopic` constructor argument to EventBus (default -1, meaning unlimited), and a `countSubscribersForTopic(topic)` helper. Extend `subscribe()` to return -1 when the topic is already at capacity. Add `int EventBus::bulkSubscribe(const std::string& topic, const std::vector<Callback>& callbacks, std::vector<int>& outIds)`, subscribing every callback in `callbacks` to `topic` in one call. Critically, get the capacity check right: the invariant is that the topic's subscriber count (existing + everything in this batch, combined) must never exceed maxSubscribersPerTopic. Compute the topic's current subscriber count and compare it plus the batch size against maxSubscribersPerTopic ONCE for the whole batch - do not check each callback individually against the pre-batch count, since that lets a batch of several callbacks sail past a cap that would reject them if counted together. Fill outIds and return 1 on success, or 0 (nothing subscribed) if the batch would overflow.
name: add_cpp_eventbus_bulk_subscribe_cumulative_capacity
